modules.module_title: Access trip information and prepare for the trip/expedition

pcs.pc_description: gather details on the itinerary of the trek/expedition/ fixed campsite program from the tour operator/ expedition/trip leader.
help the tour operator/ expedition/trip leader to prepare a detailed equipment list for the trek/expedition, eg. tents, mattresses, utensils, stoves, toilet items, etc.
check the condition of the tents, specially tent zips, lining, tent flaps, rips and tears, guy ropes and cords etc.
repair and clean tents and equipment, if required.
ensure to pack the toilet tent, toilet paper, shovel, toilet seat (if needed).
tighten the p-cords and stakes/pegs used for holding the tent to the ground if they have loosened over time and use (in case of fixed campsites).
check the toilet areas, ensure they are cleaned as per service quality standards followed in the organisation.
ensure toilets are stocked with essential items before the arrival of guests (in case of fixed campsites).

check the functioning of equipment such as stoves, gas lights, torches, water heating systems for bathing - traditional hamam or solar/gas heating systems/boilers etc. (in case of fixed campsites). etc.
repair and clean stoves, gas lights, water heating systems, if required.
coordinate with the cook and create a list of special/alternative food items to be procured to cater to allergy prone group members and guests with special dietary requirements.
assist the kitchen helpers to procure any items required.
set the dining area with tables and chairs according to the group size (for fixed campsites).
ensure dustbins are placed in every tent (in case of fixed campsites).
ensure all light fittings are in place and functioning.
pack all camp items and provisions securely in bags according to size and weight for porter or pony loading.

modules.module_title: Set up camp for smooth functioning of the program

pcs.pc_description: plan all daily camp tasks in sequence and organize supplies for easy access
• help/assist the kitchen helpers in setting up tourist/guest tents, kitchen area, dining area, • toilet and shower tents (for expeditions/treks)
• provide provisions in the toilets and toilet tents for hygiene purposes and restock as and • when required (soap, toilet paper, etc.)
clean the toilets more than once a day
help the kitchen staff in keeping the kitchen clean and presentable at all times
• ensure that hot and cold water are placed for drinking and hand washing for the • guests/tourists
• coordinate with the cook and serve hot tea, snacks and meals on time and inform about • special food for specific individuals
• get the water heating systems started and inform the guests when water is ready for bathing • (at fixed campsites)
interact with the guests to see if they need anything
• ensure repairs are made to minor tears, zippers, etc., before heading to the next campsite • (during an expedition/trek)
dismantle and pack all tents and tent parts for the next campsite (on an expedition/trek)
offer help to differently-abled people when asked for
empathize with and respect people with disabilities
• adhere to “Minimum Impact” travel policies and not leave/burn any non-biodegradable items • behind like wrappers, cigarette butts, bottles and tins
avoid single use plastic and use biodegradable packing material, wherever required
• choose tent pitching locations carefully to safeguard from avalanche, rockfall, flooding and • lightning
• establish communication with the expedition leader/ trekking guide/ trip leader/ • mountaineering instructor in case of a disaster.
• support in air and land rescue and assist in evacuating people from danger zone in case of • any disaster.
• provide shelter, to guests, till rescue arrives and deal with all eventualities in a calm and • composed manner.

kus: KU1. environmental practices to be followed during camp pack up

pcs.pc_description: ensure to cover the pit dug for toilet tents properly with earth and grass while packing up camp (in case of expeditions/treks).
assist the kitchen staff to pack out all plastics, tins, cans, paper and carry them back from the expedition for proper disposal.
segregate and dispose all waste into garbage bins after reaching the city/town

modules.module_title: Return all equipment and submit trip report

pcs.pc_description: check all tents used in expeditions/fixed campsites for any damage and ensure to get them repaired before the next group arrives
clean, dry, dismantle and pack all tents when not in use during off seasons and store them in the camp storeroom along with unused supplies (at fixed campsites).
clean, sun dry and return all the tents to the organiser (after returning from an expedition/trek).
assist the kitchen staff to clean all kitchen supplies/utensils and return all kitchen items.
check for any major damage to the tents, equipment and camp property such as crockery, tables, chairs, dustbins, buckets, mugs etc. and report to the organiser.
submit a trip report at the end of the trek/expedition.
